newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian shares close at record high, lira strong.
newsitem.headline: Italian shares close at record high, lira strong.

text.p: Italian shares closed at a new record high on Friday, lifted by a strong showing at the opening on Wall Street and lira strength against the mark and a revival of interest in giant insurer Generali.
The all-share Mibtel finished 1.37 percent higher at 14,018 and the blue chip closed at 21,380, a rise on the day of 1.67 percent.
Telecom Italia shot up by 4.45 percent to close at 5,795 lire, fuelled by a late order by a Milan brokerage house for 1.5 million shares.
Traders said they saw the market testing the 22,000 level in the coming weeks if the bull run, which has shown no sign of abating, continues to run its course.
Generali closed 2.53 percent higher at 32,943 lire and Alleanza also powered ahead in sympathy, closing 2.94 percent higher at 14,553 lire.
Ambroveneto, which has agreed to merge with savings bank Cariplo, shot up 8.16 percent to 6,707 lire.
Information group Olivetti, which has been left behind in the latest wave of investment in equities, finished almost unchanged at 479.3 lire.
